avoid_supplements.name: High-dose vitamin K supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potential interference with viral replication mechanisms; theoretical antagonism of antiviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent high-dose supplementation; monitor for reduced baloxavir effectiveness

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May alter gut flora affecting drug absorption; limited clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for any changes in efficacy; separate administration if possible

caution_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose zinc may interfere with viral protease mechanisms; theoretical interaction
caution_supplements.action: Use standard doses only; avoid megadose supplementation during treatment

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly reduce absorption of baloxavir when taken without regard to food intake
caution_foods.action: Take baloxavir with or without food consistently; high-fat meals not contraindicated but monitor response

monitoring_notes: Baloxavir has minimal drug metabolism via CYP450 enzymes, resulting in a low interaction potential. Monitor for treatment efficacy and any emerging resistance patterns during therapy.
